blocks.text: EEG test dimagh ki barqi sargarmi (electrical activity) naapta hai. Is ka bunyadi usool neurons ke darmiyan chalne wale barqi nerve impulses ko pakarna hai.

Tareeqa (procedure): EEG ke dauran sar ki jild (scalp) par dhaat ke electrodes lagaye jate hain. Yeh electrodes ek amplifier (signal bara karne wala aala) se jure hote hain. Amplifier electrodes ke pakre hue barqi signals ko bara karta hai. Phir signals record kar ke computer screen ya kaghaz par lehron (waveforms) ki shakal mein dikhaye jate hain.

blocks.alt: Sar ki jild par bohat se electrodes lage hain jin ki taarein ikatthi hoti hain, aur saath lehardaar lakeeron wala kaghaz jis par EEG reading likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.22: Electroencephalography (kitab ki Figure 15.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Istemal (uses): EEG kai asabi (neurological) halaton ki jaanch ke liye kiya jata hai, jin mein dauray (seizures), mirgi (epilepsy) aur brain tumours shamil hain. Is mein dard nahin hota aur behoshi ki dawa (sedation ya anaesthesia) ki zaroorat nahin.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text:
EEG ki har lehar dimagh ki alag halat se juri hai.
• Gamma waves aala samajh (high perception), seekhne aur masle hal karne ke kaamon se juri hain.
• Beta waves naarmal chaukas halat aur faal soch se juri hain.
• Alpha waves jismani aur zehni sukoon ki halat dikhati hain.
• Theta waves gehri neend (khwab aur kam hosh) dikhati hain.
• Delta waves sab se gehri neend aur khwab dikhati hain.

blocks.alt: Rangeen pattiyon mein EEG ki paanch lehrein: Gamma (sab se tez aur chhoti), Beta, Alpha, Theta aur Delta (sab se aahista aur sab se oonchi). Gamma se delta tak lehrein aahista aur oonchi hoti jati hain.
blocks.caption: EEG ki lehrein (kitab ke EEG wale 'For Information' box ki lehron ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar se neeche lehrein aahista aur oonchi hoti jati hain. Gamma aur beta tez aur chhoti lehrein hain jo jaagte, sochte dimagh ki hain; alpha aaram ki halat ki; theta aur delta aahista aur bari lehrein hain jo neend mein aati hain, delta sab se gehri neend mein.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Zyada tar hawale theta lehron ko ghanoodgi aur halki neend se, aur delta lehron ko gehri, be-khwab neend se jorte hain; wazeh khwab zyada tar REM neend mein aate hain, jis ka EEG jaagne (beta jaisi) halat jaisa lagta hai.

blocks.prompt: EEG mirgi (epilepsy) ke liye kyun mufeed hai?
blocks.explanation: Mirgi ke dauray dimagh mein ghair maamooli barqi sargarmi ke jhatke hain, jinhein EEG seedha aur baghair dard ke record karta hai.

items: EEG: sar par electrodes, amplifier, lehrein screen ya kaghaz par; dauron, mirgi, tumours ki jaanch; dard nahin. Lehrein: gamma, beta, alpha, theta, delta.
